properties.title: WHO outbreak notice: Chikungunya virus disease - Switzerland
properties.summary: WHO published a Disease Outbreak News notice on 17 Nov 2026: Chikungunya virus disease, Switzerland. First WHO notice naming Switzerland in two years. Relief marks this unusual for Switzerland (RL-IND-2). WHO publishes a notice after it has verified the event, often weeks after the first report.

properties.title: DREF: Central African Republic - Ebola Virus Disease Readiness
properties.summary: IFRC launched a DREF allocation for Central African Republic (Epidemic) on 17 Jun 2026. CHF 149,994 requested, CHF 149,994 funded (100%), 2,166,357 people targeted. Active; IFRC lists the end date as 31 Dec 2026. Central African Republic has had 0 IFRC appeals start in the last 90 days, against an average of 0.28 per 90 days over 2016-11-18 to 2026-08-19.
